message: Marcus — thanks for flagging the SSO dependency issue early in Sprint 1 before it became a bigger problem. Really helped me unblock the dashboard layout work.
James — exceptional work getting the CI/CD pipeline sorted so quickly in Sprint 1. The team's been able to ship with confidence ever since.
Aisha — the test coverage you put together for the auth flow in Sprint 1 caught a subtle session expiry bug before it hit client. Great catch.
Priya — your dashboard wireframes were so clear that the client approved them first time without changes. Made everyone's job easier.
